locations.note: Amicia and Hugo travel through a stylized version of Provence, exploring villages, countryside, and historic sites.
Amicia takes Hugo across the sea to La Cuna, the island from his dreams, hoping it holds a cure for the Macula.
Believing Amicia dead, Hugo gives himself over to the Macula and rats overrun Marseille; Amicia and Lucas enter the ruined city to face him.

routes.name: Amicia and Hugo de Rune
routes.note: Fleeing the rats through a sunlit Provence, the siblings sail in search of the island from Hugo's dreams, and the story ends in a Marseille overrun by the plague.
